native_physical_diagnostics.inventory_interpretation: W/U is kg/m; occupied area = sum(Wfilm/Ufilm)/rhoF + Wdrop/(Udrop*rhoF) + Wvapor/(Uvapor*rhoV). Phase-volume closure is informational for ThreeField/FourField: the original MATLAB frameworks do not impose this residual as a convergence or acceptance gate. No area-residual acceptance threshold is applied. Finite residuals and indeterminate NaN/Inf inventory or area values do not change solver acceptance; existing solver convergence and exceptions remain unchanged. AFFNC >= 1-1e-12 identifies the numerically unblended annular region for reporting, and absence of such nodes leaves that result unavailable. Common-annular mass diagnostics use a fixed downstream control volume whose upstream face and all cells satisfy this mask at every time; its residual is outflow minus inflow plus backward-Euler storage, with no storage for the initial steady state. Pre-annular values are source initialization quantities and all-region area/mass diagnostics there are descriptive. Zero/zero inventory is indeterminate and is not silently zeroed. Any four-field film-thickness caps do not independently enforce this inventory identity. Numerical convergence and algebraic flow partition do not establish mass-storage conservation or physical validation. Whether a discrepancy is shared with upstream is established by a separate reference comparison; see the baseline verification report.
